description: R=15 mm geometric feasibility of all 1024 connections of the new manual-CSV campaign (Z1 section-2 + C4-expanded Z2 section-2); per-connection template classification with explicit inequalities.

parameters.port_model: four_side_1024.fslw.ports.build_plane_endpoints (2x16 MPO, 64 connectors, 16 columns/row, 0.25 mm column pitch, 9 mm connector pitch, dual height z1=0/z2=0.5)

templates.same: straight L1 + R15 90deg arc + middle straight m + R15 90deg arc + straight L2 (r15.u_geometry quarter_pair); D = 2R + m required
templates.adjacent: straight + R15 90deg arc + straight single L; source leg = b - R, target leg = a - R, with a/b the port distances to the shared corner; both >= 0
templates.opposite: delta = 0 straight | 0 < delta < 2R two-arc short-S (theta = acos(1-delta/(2R)) each) | delta >= 2R two 90deg arcs + middle straight delta-2R
templates.vertical_s_lift: two-arc S curve in the vertical plane: footprint = 2R sin(theta), theta = acos(1-dz/(2R)); margins PORT_MARGIN 1.2 mm / SEGMENT_MARGIN 0.25 mm

s_lift.formula: footprint(dz) = 2R sin(theta), theta = acos(1 - dz/(2R)); required straight length = margin + footprint

collision_method.note: canonical representative templates only; proxy for route conflicts

judgement_class_definitions.radius_limited_2d: no template of the frozen family reaches R=15 (proven by the per-connection inequality)
judgement_class_definitions.pure90_template_limited: pure two-90deg-turn template cannot generate the connection; the frozen two-arc short-S pair can
judgement_class_definitions.rigid_template_conflict: the unique single-arc L of this adjacent pair comes closer than 0.08 mm to another unique single-arc L; both cannot share one layer -> alternative template or 3D layer needed
judgement_class_definitions.same_u_family_capacity_limited: the frozen U family has only 4 middle-straight depth tracks and this side has more overlapping U intervals than tracks -> pigeonhole proves unavoidable coincidence; ordering/layer change needed
judgement_class_definitions.conflict_needs_joint_search: template exists with free parameters but the representative geometry conflicts; joint routing search needed (not single-connection geometry)
judgement_class_definitions.lift_limited: 2D template exists but no straight is long enough for the vertical S-lift to some routing layer
judgement_class_definitions.not_limited: template exists and representative geometry is clean

same_u_family_capacity.argument: frozen r15.u_geometry U candidates only use bulge in {0, R/2, R, 2R}, so middle straights lie on 4 depth tracks; more than 4 overlapping middle-straight intervals at one x => pigeonhole => two centrelines coincide => family alone cannot route that side

adjacent_rigid_template.method: all 400 unique single-arc L centrelines sampled at 0.05 mm; point pairs closer than 0.08 mm whose tangent angle is < 5.0 deg (parallel) are counted; a pair with >= 1 mm of such parallel coincidence is reported as a substantial rigid-template conflict (crossings are permitted and not counted)

opposite_forced_conflicts.note: delta=0 straight routes are rigid; a route whose port sits on the same slot is blocked. Non-zero delta transfers slide freely along the 150 mm corridor (free s1), so no rigid pair conflict is forced by single-connection geometry.

two_d_routing_evidence.source: read-only cross-reference with the campaign phase-2 2D routing outputs (phase2_2d/<plane>/checkpoint.json, run_summary.json)

summary.note: phase-2 routing is the Lead pipeline output; it is quoted here only as an independent confirmation, never modified

z2.note: 128 quaternary-base rows, expanded by C4 to 512 connections / 1024 row-2 ports

coordinate_check.note: all CSV x/y values were compared with build_plane_endpoints routing_xy at 1e-9 mm tolerance: 0 mismatches

table.convention: source tangent = inward (travel into the board); target tangent = -inward (arrive from inside the board)

tangent_check.note: port tangents are the board-side inward normals; computed for all 2048 physical ports / 1024 connection endpoints of this campaign
